page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8is.32xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal GPU-accelerated server instance designed for high-density artificial intelligence and compute-intensive workloads. The instance is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C processors running at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz across 128 vCPUs. It features 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

Hardware acceleration is delivered by eight NVIDIA L20 GPUs built on the Ada Lovelace architecture, aggregating 384 GB of dedicated GDDR6 VRAM across the system (48 GB per GPU). For network connectivity, the instance provides a high baseline throughput of 170 Gbps. The platform does not bundle local storage, requiring network-attached cloud storage volumes to persist operating system and application data.

Given its combination of multi-GPU compute density, extensive video memory, and 170 Gbps networking capacity, ecs.ebmgn8is.32xlarge functions effectively for distributed deep learning inference, large language model serving, enterprise computer vision processing, and accelerated scientific computing pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8is.32xlarge is an enterprise-tier GPU-accelerated bare-metal instance designed for computationally intensive tasks. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon 6462C processors clocked at 3.3 GHz, supported by 1024.0 GB of system RAM at a generous ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The acceleration subsystem integrates eight NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L20 GPUs providing a combined 384 GB of VRAM, with each accelerator supplying 48 GB of memory. Network traffic is accommodated by a 170 Gbps baseline interface. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, necessitating remote network block storage. This hardware balance suits parallelized AI inference workloads, large-scale video transcoding pipelines, computer vision frameworks, and dense graphics acceleration jobs requiring massive aggregate memory and GPU parallelism.
